label: sparse: mid/late original-phase steps in sequences starting l/x/1 that contain b (often b,k)
explanation: Extremely sparse feature (0.002% of steps), with weak, low-magnitude activations (max 0.18). Activity is concentrated in the original phase at t=3..8 and at the delimiter, plus a few copy-phase steps at recall_idx 0 or 3. It is enriched in sequences whose first token is l, x or 1 (about 77% of mass) and that contain b early on, usually at position 2 or 3, often followed by k (prev_tok k gives 11x lift, prev2_tok b gives 12.6x). It never fires at t<3. The best simple predicate (first token in {l,x,1}, b already seen, not copy phase) covers about 68% of mass on dev, but its precision is about 0.3%, and adding conditions (a b/k pair, b at position 2) only raises precision to 1-5% while recall falls. No coherent description separates the active steps from the many similar inactive contexts, and I found nothing that clearly modulates magnitude.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=3 & in_tok=l (+3.53), orig2=b (+3.34), phase=2 & out_tok=l (+3.23), orig0=l (+2.92), orig0=1 (+2.87), orig0=x (+2.63). Lower it: phase=2 (-2.51), prev3_tok=- (-1.90), orig_idx=-1 (-1.25), next_out=- (-1.06).
